claims.claim: An adult who appears to need care and support is eligible for a needs assessment.
claims.quote: Where it appears to a local authority that an adult may have needs for care and support, the authority must assess
claims.note: The Care Act states the assessment duty for an adult who may need care and support.

claims.claim: The need for care and support must be due to a physical or mental condition, disability, or frailty due to age.
claims.note: The supplied text does not prescribe these causes as a condition for assessment.

claims.claim: Any adult can request a care needs assessment from their local authority.
claims.quote: The needs assessment is free and anyone can ask for one. How to get a needs assessment Contact social services at your local council and ask for a needs assessment.
claims.note: The NHS page says anyone can ask their local council for one.

claims.claim: The care needs assessment itself is free.
claims.quote: The needs assessment is free and anyone can ask for one.
claims.note: The NHS page explicitly says the assessment is free.

claims.claim: The assessment is independent of the adult’s financial means.
claims.quote: The duty to carry out a needs assessment applies regardless of the authority's view of—  (a) the level of the adult's needs for care and support, or  (b) the level of the adult's financial resources.
claims.note: The Care Act says the assessment duty applies regardless of financial resources.

claims.quote: If the assessment identifies you need help, you will have a financial assessment (means test) to see if the council will pay towards it.
claims.note: The NHS page says there may be a financial assessment for resulting care.

claims.claim: The assessment can lead to a care plan.
claims.note: The supplied page does not say the assessment leads to a care plan.

claims.claim: The assessment can lead to funded support.
claims.quote: If the assessment identifies you need help, you will have a financial assessment (means test) to see if the council will pay towards it.
claims.note: The NHS page says the council may pay toward identified support after a financial assessment.
